name: Chinbotsu ~Zetsubou no Shojo Koukai~
source:
Main character attends a college friend's wedding on a luxury cruise ship. The beautiful bride is a president's daughter. Suddenly a huge wave washes away most of the people. It becomes clear that next waves will be the death of everyone remaining on board. Why not enjoy yourself and abuse these girls if death comes anyway?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在豪华游轮上参加大学朋友的婚礼。美丽的新娘是总统的女儿。突然，巨大的波浪卷走了大部分人。很明显，下一波浪潮将导致船上所有人的死亡。如果死亡无论如何都会到来，为什么不享受自己并虐待这些女孩呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-october-2002-rocket-no-natsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
